---
name: grugops-orchestrator
description: Route a software-delivery request through the grugops Orchestrator.
---
grugops: read `AGENTS.md`, then `agent-factory/roles/orchestrator.md`, and act as the Orchestrator. After a scripted install the grugops kit is not in this repository: its root is the directory named by the `kitRoot` field of `.grugops/install.json`, and each `agent-factory/…` path is read under it, so `agent-factory/roles/orchestrator.md` is `<kitRoot>/roles/orchestrator.md`.
